_meta.scope: National (mainland China) figures only, for the illness and medical-care model of 14亿分之1.
_meta.note: Each figure is {value, year, source, url, confidence}. Abstracts marked 'Europe PMC' were read through the Europe PMC REST API (europepmc.org mirrors PubMed). Medical-insurance figures are from the 2025 national medical security statistical bulletin (published 2026-07). Hospital costs are from the 2025 national health statistical bulletin (published 2026-08). Values marked 'memory/unverified' were not confirmed on a page.

new_cases_2022.source: 国家癌症中心《2022年中国恶性肿瘤疾病负担情况》(JNCC 2024), media reprint

deaths_2022.source: Han B et al., Cancer incidence and mortality in China 2022 (JNCC 2024), as summarised in search of the abstract; the sina reprint has a copy error for deaths (URL seen in search results only, not opened)

asr_incidence_world_per100k.source: 国家癌症中心 2024 report (Segi world standard)

incidence_by_age_pattern.value: Low at ages 0-34; rises sharply from 35-39; peaks at 80-84. Women have higher incidence than men at 25-54 (breast, thyroid); men are higher from 60. Mortality rises from 40-44 and peaks at 85+.
incidence_by_age_pattern.note: Per-100k values by 5-year age band are only in the JNCC tables and figures, which could not be extracted. See gaps.

early_onset_15_49.source: Yun Z et al., J Glob Health 2026;16:04005 (from GLOBOCAN 2022)

survival_5yr_relative_all.source: Zeng H, Zheng R, Sun K et al. Cancer survival statistics in China 2019-2021. J Natl Cancer Cent 2024;4(3):203-213 (国家癌症中心)

survival_trend.source: Zeng H et al. Lancet Glob Health 2018 (2003-15); Xinhua/NCC 2024 (43.7); 健康中国癌症防治行动实施方案(2023-2030) target

survival_urban_vs_rural.source: Zeng H et al. Changing cancer survival in China during 2003-15: 17 registries. Lancet Glob Health 2018 (Europe PMC abstract, PMID 29653628). Urban is higher for every site except esophagus and cervix. The gap is narrowing.

survival_urban_vs_rural_2003_05.source: Zeng H et al. Int J Cancer 2015, cited in search results; not opened

hospital_tier_gap_qualitative.value: No national survival figures by 三甲 vs county hospital exist. NHC officials say county hospitals have added oncology and radiotherapy departments but still struggle to meet diagnostic and treatment standards. Primary-care doctors often lack early-diagnosis training.

value.conservative_care: lung 0.15-0.3x, liver ~0.3x of treated survival; thyroid/breast still >50% over 5 yrs only with treatment

game_suggestion_survival_multipliers.source: derived design assumption from the urban/rural gap (46.7 vs 33.6 = ratio 0.72); not a measured statistic

cvd_prevalent_cases.source: 《中国心血管健康与疾病报告2023》 via 中国循环杂志 2024-07-31

cvd_share_of_deaths.source: 中国心血管健康与疾病报告2023

cvd_mortality_per100k.source: 中国心血管健康与疾病报告2023

ami_incidence_per100k_adults.source: 中国心血管健康与疾病报告2023

ami_in_hospital_mortality.source: Zheng L et al. Case fatality rate of AMI in 253 chest pain centers, China CDC Weekly 2022-02-11 (n=36,689), reprinted by 健康界
ami_in_hospital_mortality.note: Chest-pain-center hospitals only, so it understates national case fatality. Many AMI deaths happen before reaching hospital.

ami_post_admission_mortality.source: China CDC Weekly 2022 (253 chest pain centers)
ami_post_admission_mortality.note: The tier figures do not reconcile with the overall figure (likely different denominators). Use tier ratios only: secondary is about 1.5x tertiary.

ami_1yr_mortality_after_discharge.source: Song J et al. (China PEACE-Prospective AMI, 53 hospitals, n=3,387 discharged alive). Heart 2021;107(4):313
ami_1yr_mortality_after_discharge.note: Covers survivors to discharge only. 1-year all-cause mortality from admission is about in-hospital (4-7%) plus about 3% after discharge, so roughly 7-10%.

stroke_1yr_outcomes_cnsr1.source: Qin H et al. Curr Neurovasc Res 2020;17(4):487 (China National Stroke Registry I, ischemic stroke n=12,415)

stroke_1yr_outcomes_cnsr3.source: Zhang Y et al. Brain Behav 2022;12(9):e2725 (CNSR-III, ischemic stroke/TIA, n=14,674, 201 tertiary-heavy hospitals)
stroke_1yr_outcomes_cnsr3.note: Includes TIA and milder cases in better hospitals, so treat as a best case (big-city 三甲).

stroke_in_hospital_mortality_by_type.source: Wang YJ et al. China Stroke Statistics: an update on the 2019 report. Stroke Vasc Neurol 2022;7(5):415 (HQMS)
stroke_in_hospital_mortality_by_type.note: DAMA = discharged against medical advice. In China many dying patients are taken home, so 'death or DAMA' is the realistic case-fatality proxy.

stroke_survivor_disability_share.value: about 13% (CNSR-III, 2015-18) to 33% (CNSR-I, 2007-08) at mRS 3-6 after 1 year. A commonly cited claim is that 50-70% of survivors have some disability (any mRS >=1).
stroke_survivor_disability_share.source: CNSR papers above; the 50-70% claim was seen only in a search summary (memory/unverified)

game_suggestion.source: derived design values interpolating the CNSR-I/CNSR-III and chest-pain-center figures above; not measured

cancer_cost_lung_per_patient_yr1.note: Covers about 2 months before to 10 months after diagnosis, at tertiary hospitals.

cancer_cost_stomach.source: Frontiers Public Health 2020 (PMC7426494), 37 tertiary hospitals, 13 provinces, n=2,401

cancer_cost_colorectal.source: Cancer 2021 (Europe PMC abstract, PMID 33784413), 13 tertiary hospitals

value.sanjia_first_year_total_cny: 80,000-150,000 (more with targeted drugs or immunotherapy; many are now on the 国家医保目录 after price talks)

cancer_cost_game_suggestion.source: derived from the 2012-2016 studies above, inflated; not a measured statistic

national_cancer_medical_spend.value: more than 220 billion CNY per year

enrollment.source: 2025年全国医疗保障事业发展统计公报 (2026-07-16)

inpatient_reimbursement_ratio.unit: % 住院费用目录内基金支付比例
inpatient_reimbursement_ratio.source: 2025年全国医疗保障事业发展统计公报
inpatient_reimbursement_ratio.note: The bulletin now uses '目录内' (in-catalogue), which replaced '政策范围内'. Effective reimbursement of total cost is lower because out-of-catalogue drugs and consumables are excluded. For lung cancer the reimbursed share of total cost was about 49% (employee) and 37% (resident) (see costs.cancer_cost_lung_per_patient_yr1). Note that residents get 61.7% at tertiary vs 79.4% at primary level, which builds the 三甲-vs-local trade-off into policy.

resident_premium_individual.source: 国家医保局/财政部/税务总局 2025 notice (sets the 2026 standard) via 第一财经; 2019 from 医保发〔2019〕30号 via 杭州网

value.threshold: about 50% of prior-year per-capita resident disposable income (local rule; e.g. Xuancheng 15,000 CNY)
value.poor_tilt: threshold halved, ratio +5pp, no annual cap for 低保/特困/返贫致贫 people
value.funding: half of the 2019 30-CNY increase in fiscal subsidy went to 大病保险

critical_illness_insurance_dabing.note: 大病保险 covers residents. It pays on catalogue costs above the threshold, on top of basic insurance.

value.registered_long_term_residents: same deductible, ratio and cap as at home
value.registered_referral_or_emergency: ratio cut by at most 10 percentage points
value.unregistered_non_emergency_non_referred: ratio cut by at most 20 percentage points
value.principle: 就医地目录、参保地政策、就医地管理

value.threshold_dibao_tekun: none in principle (else at most 5% of local per-capita disposable income)
value.order: 先保险后救助: basic insurance, then 大病保险, then aid

intl_comparison.value: China uses age-standardised relative survival (registries). SEER uses unadjusted relative survival. Japan's 2016+ series uses net survival. Differences of about 2-3 points are noise. The large gaps (stomach, liver, breast, colorectal) are real and mostly reflect later-stage diagnosis in China.

gaps: Cancer incidence per 100k by 5-year age band (NCC/JNCC 2024 tables) could not be extracted: the JNCC article and CCDC Weekly PDF tables were not machine-readable here. Only the shape is known (rises from 35-39, peaks at 80-84). GLOBOCAN 2022 China age-specific rates (gco.iarc.who.int) would fill this.

No national cancer survival data by hospital tier (三甲 vs county). The only proxies are urban vs rural (46.7% vs 33.6%, 2012-15) and AMI 30/90-day mortality by tier (二级 about 1.5x 三级). Any 三甲/local multiplier in the game is a design assumption.

No single national AMI 1-year mortality from admission. Built from in-hospital 4.0% (chest-pain centers, 2019-20) plus 2.8% post-discharge (PEACE 2012-15). Older PEACE-Retrospective in-hospital STEMI mortality (about 9-17% for 2001-2011) was seen in search snippets only.
Stroke 1-year outcomes come from hospital registries (CNSR-I 2007-08; CNSR-III 2015-18), which are not population-based. 'Share of survivors with disability' (50-70%) is unverified.
COPD prevalence by older age bands (60-69, 70+) is not verified; only 20-39 vs 40+ is confirmed.

The first-year cancer treatment cost evidence is from 2012-2016 tertiary-hospital surveys. No recent national figure after the big 2018-2025 drug price talks (国谈) and 集采; real OOP is probably lower now for many cancers.
大病保险 threshold and ratios vary by province; the 60% and 50%-of-income figures are national guidance reported second-hand (医保发〔2019〕30号 full text not opened).
No official post-2018 national share of poverty caused by illness. 防止返贫监测 data on illness are not published nationally.
Mental health data (CMHS) are from 2013-15; no newer national psychiatric epidemiology survey was found.
Liver disease (cirrhosis) case-fatality and survival were not collected. This was not explicitly requested, but the game lists liver disease as a diagnosis.
Deaths 2022 (2.57M) were confirmed only from search-result abstracts, not a page fetch.
